About us

A community built by people, for people.

Tech Orbit Hub brings together students, developers, AI enthusiasts, designers, robotics builders and tech creators to collaborate and build real technology projects.

Our vision: the biggest, friendliest tech community in the world — where a student in Kerala, a designer in Dubai and a data analyst in Berlin can team up on the same idea.

What we believe

🌍

Open to all

IT or not — if you love building and learning, you belong.

🛠️

Build real things

Less talk, more shipping. Projects over certificates.

❤️

Support each other

No gatekeeping. Ask anything, help anyone.

Questions

Is it free?

Yes, completely free.

Do I need to be in IT?

No. We welcome professionals and learners from every field who love technology.

I’m a beginner. Is that okay?

Absolutely — the Learning Circle is made for you.

Can I bring my friends?

Please do! The bigger the orbit, the better.

Learning hub

Pick a path. Level up together.

Free roadmaps and resources for every tribe, from zero to building. Study alone or join the Learning Circle.

Join the Learning Circle

Roadmaps by tribe

💻 Developer

HTML → CSS → JavaScript → a framework → build a real project. roadmap.sh · freeCodeCamp · MDN Learn

📊 Data analyst

Excel → SQL → Python → visualisation → portfolio dashboards. Kaggle Learn · roadmap.sh

🎨 Designer

Layout and colour → typography → UX basics → Figma → case studies. Laws of UX

🤖 AI & Robotics

Python → ML basics → train a model → deploy it. For hardware, start with a microcontroller. fast.ai · Arduino Education

🌱 Complete beginner

Start with a free intro course, then pick a tribe. CS50

Learn in public

Share what you learned this week in the Learning Circle. Teaching is the fastest way to learn.
